title: arifOS Federation Content Model Schema
description: Every page in the arif-fazil.com federation must declare a content model conforming to this schema. Pages render from the content model. Agents edit the content model, not random HTML.
doctrine: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — If the content model is missing or invalid, the page is BANGANG. The page is the rendering of the model, not the source.

title.description: Page title. One per page. The h1.

audience.description: Primary audience. Determines register and bridge to agent surface.

intent.description: What is this page for? What does the reader walk away with?

ring.description: Which scope does this page belong to? Determines accent, pattern, and templates.

href.description: Canonical path or subdomain URL. NEVER a chain.

grade.description: Button grade from components.json. SEAL=solid, HOLD=dashed, VOID=red hold-to-confirm.

proof_actions.description: Additional proof actions (e.g. /999 seal entries, audit trails)

epistemic_register.description: Voice. EMPATHY for human-side prose; MARUAH for kernel/audit surfaces. F6 dual-register.

epistemic_labels.description: Evidence labels for the claims on this page. F2 TRUTH.

ring_accents.description: Color tokens used on this page. Must come from design-tokens.json domain_accents.

template.description: Template from templates.json. Three templates for human; agent override for agent surface.

toroidal.description: ONE toroidal anchor per page. NE-BOTH rule from geometry.json.

toroidal_rationale.description: Why this torus choice. E.g. 'trinity-tile page with AAA bridge emphasis' or 'flat-surface mission-driven'.

primary_organ.description: Which organ this page belongs to. null for cross-cutting pages like /laws.

mcp_endpoint.description: Canonical MCP endpoint for this page's organ. From tool-surfaces.json.

human_voice_prose.description: Page body in EMPATHY voice (human-side narrative).

agent_voice_prose.description: Page body in MARUAH voice (audit-grade). Used for /mcp/ JSON.

ring_geometry.description: Visual rule for this page. Must match toroidal.

breadcrumbs.description: Optional. If absent, derived from URL path by navigation.json.

parent_route.description: Canonical parent path. Used for prev_next_nav.

prev_route.description: Previous page in the linear narrative. null if no prev.

next_route.description: Next page in the linear narrative. null if no next.

ring_layout.description: Optional human-readable layout description for the page.

primary_organ_endpoint.description: MCP affordance button href. Should be the organ's MCP endpoint.

torus_geometry.description: Three-arcs geometry for trinity_ring torus. Future schemas.

ground_truth_provenance.description: Where does the truth on this page come from?

examples.title: WELL — Human Vitality
examples.intent: Show the human-readiness surface of the federation. Substrate, dignity, witness.
examples.toroidal_rationale: Organ page with constellation emphasis; trinity ring at top of organ card grid.
examples.human_voice_prose: WELL observes human and machine readiness. It does not diagnose. It does not prescribe. It holds the substrate.
examples.agent_voice_prose: WELL: REFLECT_ONLY posture. L2 readiness. Observes human substrate. No diagnoses, no prescriptions.

validation_rules.name: ring_matches_template
validation_rules.rule: ring and template must be consistent (e.g. organ-page must have a primary_organ)

validation_rules.name: epistemic_register_matches_audience
validation_rules.rule: audience=human → register=EMPATHY; audience=agent → register=MARUAH; audience=auditor → register=MARUAH

validation_rules.name: primary_action_grade_consistent
validation_rules.rule: primary_action.grade must be from components.json. No HOLD buttons in organ-page primary_action.

validation_rules.name: toroidal_rationale_required
validation_rules.rule: toroidal_rationale must be present if toroidal is not 'none'

validation_rules.name: ring_accents_only_from_canon
validation_rules.rule: ring_accents must be valid var(--color-N) tokens from design-tokens.json

validation_rules.name: mcp_endpoint_in_tool_surfaces
validation_rules.rule: mcp_endpoint must be present in tool-surfaces.json

validation_rules.name: primary_organ_endpoint_matches_mcp
validation_rules.rule: primary_organ_endpoint must equal mcp_endpoint or its canonical path
